State Farm Insurance.activity_summary: The State Farm group reports property and casualty insurance, life insurance, health insurance, investment planning services, and third-party financial products through separately managed affiliates.
State Farm Insurance.entity_scope_note: The group expressly states that insurance operations consist of multiple property-and-casualty and life companies managed at affiliate level.

New York Life.activity_summary: New York Life describes its mutual-company mission as helping families and businesses achieve financial security through insurance, annuity, investment, and advisor-supported financial solutions.
New York Life.entity_scope_note: The reviewed source is issued to policy owners by the mutual company and is not dependent on a listed-company SEC identity.

sources.title: 2025 Nationwide Annual Report — Products and Rankings

Nationwide.activity_summary: Nationwide reports a deliberately diversified mutual portfolio spanning personal and commercial insurance, specialty and reinsurance, annuities, life insurance, retirement solutions, group benefits, investment management, and agribusiness.
Nationwide.entity_scope_note: Nationwide distinguishes the mutual parent, life entities, property-and-casualty affiliates, and diversified product businesses.

Publix Super Markets.activity_summary: Publix is an employee-owned supermarket operator and retailer whose 2025 Form 10-K provides first-party reporting even though its common stock is not publicly traded on a national exchange.
Publix Super Markets.entity_scope_note: Private ownership does not prevent first-party regulatory evidence or a resolved legal reporting entity.

USAA.activity_summary: USAA reports member-focused insurance, banking, payments and credit-card services, catastrophe claims support, and digital account servicing for the military community.
USAA.entity_scope_note: The USAA association operates through multiple regulated financial and insurance entities while presenting a unified member experience.

sources.title: TIAA Retirement Income, Planning, Investing, and Advice
TIAA Privacy Notice — The TIAA Companies

TIAA.activity_summary: TIAA and affiliated companies provide retirement annuities, investment management, securities distribution, advisory, trust and custody services, and related retirement-income solutions through distinct regulated entities and the Nuveen investment-management family.
TIAA.entity_scope_note: TIAA's own disclosure enumerates insurance, investment-company, investment-adviser, securities-distribution, trust-bank, and wealth-management entities under the shared corporate identity.

Liberty Mutual Insurance Group.activity_summary: Liberty Mutual describes three major business units: Personal Insurance Lines, Commercial Insurance Lines including specialty, surety and reinsurance, and Liberty Mutual Investments managing the group's financial assets.
Liberty Mutual Insurance Group.entity_scope_note: Business-unit and subsidiary scope is essential because personal insurance, commercial insurance, reinsurance, and investment activities are not a single undifferentiated parent capability.

sources.title: MassMutual 2025 Financial Summary and Annual Report

Massachusetts Mutual Life.activity_summary: MassMutual reports life insurance, annuities, investment and asset-management activities, including affiliated businesses such as Barings and MassMutual Ascend, and publishes consolidated and entity-specific statutory reporting.
Massachusetts Mutual Life.entity_scope_note: The reporting distinguishes the mutual parent, subsidiaries, affiliated asset managers, annuity businesses, and separate statutory insurance entities.
